https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models?hl=es-419#gemini-3-pro-image-preview

Esta app no se centra en ser estable, se centra en usar la vanguardia aunque no siempre funcione a la perfeccion.

I'm now prioritizing `gemini-3-pro-image-preview` for image generation, explicitly moving away from the older `imagen-4.0-generate-001` and `gemini-2.5-flash-image` models. This transition is underway to leverage the improved capabilities of the new model.

The current focus is on adapting the function signature and response handling to match the `generateContent` method.

This ensures users have selected an API key before they can use the application's image generation features.

I'm now revising my plans to ensure a smooth transition to `gemini-3-pro-image-preview`. I also will stick to a 1K default image size unless specified, as the system instruction suggests. Furthermore, the UI already supports all valid aspect ratios for the new model, which is a significant plus.

Now I'm implementing a crucial step: blocking the main app until the user selects their API key. I'll add `hasApiKey` state to `App.tsx` and use `useEffect` to check `window.aistudio.hasSelectedApiKey()`. I need to ensure the `GoogleGenAI` instance is initialized correctly in `geminiService.ts` after the key is selected.
